rationale.conceptual: The method is an established quantum chemistry protocol (DFT) with a standard functional/basis set. Reproducing it demands proper choice of spin states for 3d metals, construction of different coordination isomers, and extraction of the antisymmetric OCO stretch from several modes. While not a new method, it requires non-trivial domain knowledge to set up the calculations correctly.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves generating multiple initial geometries, running geometry optimizations and frequency calculations for ~15 distinct systems (metals × spin states × isomers), scaling frequencies uniformly, and then extracting relative energies and the highest-frequency antisymmetric OCO mode in a window. This multi-stage workflow with a specialized package (Psi4/ORCA) and careful data handling is a moderate orchestration challenge.
